title: 'मानसि' उपन्यासमा लैंगिकता {Sexuality in the Novel 'Manasi'}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा बलदेव मजगैयाँद्वारा रचित ‘मानसी’ उपन्यासको लैङ्गिकताको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । लैङ्गिक समालोचनाले कृति विश्लेषणका लागि अगाडि सारेका पितृसत्ता, शरीर, लैङ्गिक विभेद, लैङ्गिक सशक्तीकरण, उत्पादक तथा पुनरुत्पादक भूमिकाको सैद्धान्तिक पर्याधार तयार पारी यिनै पर्याधारका आधारमा उपन्यासको विश्लेषण गरिएकोछ । यस उपन्यासमा पितृसत्तात्मक समाज र त्यसको सामाजिक र सांस्कृतिक संरचनाको चिरफार गरी समाजनिर्मित लैङ्गिक विभेदबाट नारीलाई मुक्त गराउनुपर्ने स्वर प्रकट गरिएको छ । नेपाली समाजमा विद्यमान विभेदको कलात्मक चित्र उतारी विभेदका विरुद्धमानारीहरूले विभेदकारी संस्कृति र आफूमाथिको दमन तथा हिंसाका विरुद्धमा सशक्त रूपमा आवाज उठाउन थालेको यथार्थताजन्य सकारात्मकतालाई सशक्त रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरेको छ । पुरुषले गर्ने दमन, हिंसा तथा विभेदकारी कदमलाई पितृसत्तात्मक समाजको संस्कृतिले संरक्षण प्रदान गरेको दृष्टान्त प्रस्तुत गर्दै पुरुषप्रधान समाजमा नारीलाई भोग्या वस्तु ठान्दै प्रेम गरेर वा प्रेमको नाटक गरेर तथा कठिन परिस्थितिमा सहयोग गरेको नाटक गरेर अनि झुटो आश्वासन दिएर हिंसा, शरीरमाथि आफ्नो अधिकार जमाउन प्रयास, दमन र शोषणगरेर महिलालाई आफ्नो अधीनस्त बनाउन चाहन्छन् भन्ने यथार्थतालाई जीवन्त शैलीमा व्यक्त गरिएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In the present article, a study of gender in the novel 'Manasi,' composed by Baldev Mazgaiya, is conducted. Having prepared a theoretical framework encompassing patriarchy, the body, gender discrimination, gender empowerment, and productive and reproductive roles put forward by gender criticism for literary analysis, the novel is analyzed on the basis of these frameworks. In this novel, dissecting patriarchal society and its social and cultural structures, a voice is expressed calling for women to be liberated from socially constructed gender discrimination. Painting an artistic picture of the discrimination existing in Nepali society, it powerfully presents the reality-based positivity of women beginning to raise their voices forcefully against discriminatory culture and against the oppression and violence directed at them in opposition to discrimination. Presenting illustrations of how the culture of patriarchal society provides protection to male oppression, violence, and discriminatory actions, it concludes that the reality of how men in a male-dominated society regard women as objects of pleasure and seek to subjugate them through love or pretense of love, feigned assistance in difficult situations, false promises, violence, attempts to establish control over their bodies, oppression, and exploitation is expressed in a vivid style.

informal_english: In this article, we take a close look at gender dynamics in the novel 'Manasi,' composed by Baldev Mazgaiya. Having set up a theoretical framework around patriarchy, the body, gender discrimination, female empowerment, and productive and reproductive roles drawn from gender criticism, the novel is analyzed on the basis of these frameworks. In this novel, taking apart patriarchal society and its social and cultural structures, a voice speaks right up calling for women to be liberated from socially constructed gender discrimination. Painting an artistic picture of discrimination across Nepali society, it really highlights the positive, real-world shift where women have started speaking up forcefully against a discriminatory culture and against the oppression and violence directed at them. Highlighting how patriarchal culture shields male oppression, violence, and discrimination, it wraps up by pointing out in a vivid style how men in a male-dominated society treat women as objects of pleasure and seek to keep them under their thumb through love or faked affection, pretending to help in tough situations, false promises, violence, attempts to take control over their bodies, oppression, and exploitation.
